verdict.rationale: WorkOS documents that its SSO service works with any IdP supporting SAML or OIDC. It positions enterprise single sign-on as core, with self-serve IT-admin onboarding. Independent users praise its SAML configuration wizard and SSO wrapper, and one credits its built-in integrations with many providers. Missing for 10: explicit first-party documentation naming Okta, Entra, and Google Workspace as supported IdP connections, and IdP-specific setup guides (one community member wished for these).
